_about: A.S.R.A. entity catalog: entity_id -> dossier shown once the player logs it with the field scanner (scripts/Player/scanner.gd, hold Q). The id matches the "asra_id" meta the entity script sets in _enter_tree(); new entities register a block here and add _enter_tree() + scan_points() like the others (see asra_archive.gd).

mannequin.behavior_vector: Idles in crowds of visually identical copies; freezes when observed directly, closes distance when unseen.
mannequin.directive: Keep at least one in direct line of sight at all times. Do not enter a room containing more than three.

bacteria.behavior_vector: Roams on scent and sound; screeches on first sighting, then closes at pursuit speed. Feigns loss of target to lurk near last known position.
bacteria.directive: Do not run in a straight line. Break sound discipline only as a last resort.

eyes.behavior_vector: Manifests only under severe cognitive decay; opens at range down a sightline and tracks the subject's gaze without approach.
eyes.directive: Do not stare back. Restore ambient light or lose the sightline to clear the manifestation.

mimic.behavior_vector: Adopts the subject's own gait and silhouette at range before approaching under cover of misidentification.
mimic.directive: Treat any unexplained figure matching your own profile as hostile. Do not approach to confirm.

killer.behavior_vector: Holds position until a trigger condition is met, then closes on the nearest subject without hesitation.
killer.directive: Do not linger near unexplained stationary figures. Evacuate the area immediately on sighting.
